title: Broadstone
html_source: Broadstone (Irish: An Clochán Leathan) is one of the three neighbourhoods that make up present-day Phibsboro. Former Dublin terminus of the Midland Great Western Railway. So she may be taking a carriage to the train station to go out to the country.
